messages:
sam: Hey infra — can someone take a quick look at https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/428? It's a Terraform change to add an IAM policy for GPU nodes + NAT route for the new gpu-pool in us-west-2. Plan looks fine but I want another pair of eyes on the IAM scope and the cross-account role assumption. I left inline comments in the PR. Targeting apply tonight ~21:00 PT if no objections. Need 1 more approval and infra on-call sign-off. @miguel if you have a minute? :pray:

lina: on it, checking IAM scope and module usage. left a comment to avoid wildcard SSM resources — suggest tightening to the instance profile ARNs. small nit: module call has region hardcoded to "us-west-2", prefer var.region so it's reusable. :eyes:

miguel: quick notes: +1 on tightening policy. Also prefer explicit depends_on between the launch template module and the gpu autoscaling group so rollout order is deterministic. watch the subnet mapping — ensure GPUs land in private subnets with NAT access, not in public. I'll do a full pass in ~30m.

lina: suggested snippet in PR for restricted SSM policy:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_policy" "gpu_node_ssm" {
  name   = "gpu-node-ssm-access"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Action = ["ssm:SendCommand", "ssm:GetInventory"],
      Effect = "Allow",
      Resource = ["arn:aws:ec2:${var.region}:${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:instance/*"]
    }]
  })
}
```

alyssa: LGTM after Lina's IAM change — approved the PR. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI: terraform plan checks passed (run #789). No drifts detected.

sam: thanks all. I'll hold apply until Miguel confirms the backup job finishes. Tentative reschedule to 23:00 PT. If Miguel gives thumbs up earlier I can move it. :shipit:

miguel: backup finishes ~22:45 PT — OK to apply at 23:00. :+1:

sam: great, thanks — merging once CI is green and then applying at 23:00 PT. If anything blocks I'll post an update here. :calendar:
